visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white blazer over a white button-up shirt with black buttons and black trousers, stands at a wooden-framed doorway. He holds a green glass bottle with a golden stag-head topper in his right hand. The background shows a warmly lit indoor reception area with tables and a bar. (2) The scene shifts outdoors to a gravel courtyard during daylight. A woman in a pink, strapless, layered tulle dress with a fluffy skirt performs an energetic dance routine. A crowd of onlookers in white or light-colored attire surrounds her, many holding smartphones to record the performance. (3) Two hands, one from the man in the white suit and one from the woman in the pink dress, come together against a plain tan wall to form a heart shape with their fingers. (4) The man and woman perform a synchronized, high-energy dance routine together in front of a white floral arch set against a wooden fence. The camera uses rapid cuts and dynamic handheld movements to follow their spinning and jumping. (5) The performance concludes with the man lifting the woman horizontally in his arms. They share a kiss as ground-based cold-spark pyrotechnics ignite behind them, showering the scene in white sparks while the crowd cheers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy, four-on-the-floor EDM remix of a pop song begins instantly, characterized by a bright synthesizer lead and a heavy electronic kick drum. Over the music, a dense layer of high-arousal crowd noise is heard, including several female-identifying individuals cheering and laughing loudly. (2) The female vocal track of the BGM becomes prominent, delivering rhythmic pop lyrics. The crowd noise subsides slightly but remains as a consistent texture of applause and excited murmurs synchronized with the beat. (3) The music undergoes a momentary filter sweep, followed by an intense percussive build-up. The crowd's cheering spikes in volume and pitch, reacting to a visible peak in the performance. (4) The loud music suddenly cuts to near-silence for a brief second of strategic pause. A deep, calm male voice speaks a single line of dialogue with clear articulation and a falling intonation. (5) The music explodes back into a celebratory chorus accompanied by the distinct, high-frequency crackling sound of cold-spark pyrotechnics and a final crescendo of collective screaming and whistling from the crowd.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a choreographed and highly energetic wedding dance performance between a bride and groom, capturing the joyful and celebratory atmosphere for social media sharing.
